purpose: The only way a pathway may leave the paid_packet_intended denominator, or move between any two closure categories, is a signed record here. The generator reads this register before it reads any other evidence, so a reclassification is always a deliberate, attributable act rather than a side effect of a code or data change.

validReasons.no_participant_filing: Legal evidence that the participant has no filing to prepare on this route: relief is automatic, or a court, prosecutor, agency or other actor controls the action.
validReasons.product_scope_decision: An explicit product-scope decision by Roger that this route is outside the paid product.

invalidReasons: a missing or unacquired official form
stale or pending review of any kind
authorityRule: authority must name the person who made the decision. A reason of no_participant_filing additionally requires evidence citing the legal source that establishes there is no participant filing. A reason of product_scope_decision requires authority to be Roger.
